page.layout: One printed page, single column of text, heading centred at top; show-through text from the reverse page in the lower half is not transcribed.

main_text.head: DEDICATORIA.
main_text.p: nunc erit, vt Deo Patri & Domino nostro Iesu Christo pro his & aliis omnibus bonis, quae in nos confert, gratias immortales agamus, & Domini Gualtheri industria & φιλοπονίᾳ pro virili nostra imitati Domini vineam excolere studeamus, quo tandem & nos officio vitaq; functi gloriae coronam abeo reportemus. Ei sit laus & gloria in secula seculorum.

page.notes: The Greek word in the fourth line of the paragraph is φιλοπονίᾳ as best read; the scan is worn there. The line "vitaq; functi" is read as printed with a small superscript mark over the q, uncertain. Show-through text from the reverse page is left out.
